```python
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import tempfile
import shutil
import os

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/58109/1_58109_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/58109_1_d4eeb184/1_58109_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Load workbook and place the corrected Excel formula in the exact requested cell I6.
wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

formula = '=SUMIFS(B:B,A:A,">"&WORKDAY(I4,-4),A:A,"<="&I4)'
ws["I6"] = formula

# Compute the same result as a cached value so the workbook is unambiguous even when read without recalculation.
today = ws["I4"].value
if isinstance(today, datetime):
    today_date = today.date()
elif isinstance(today, date):
    today_date = today
else:
    today_date = datetime.fromisoformat(str(today)).date()

# Excel WORKDAY(I4,-4): move back 4 weekdays from today, excluding weekends.
threshold = today_date
workdays = 0
while workdays < 4:
    threshold -= timedelta(days=1)
    if threshold.weekday() < 5:  # Monday-Friday
        workdays += 1

cached_sum = 0
for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    d = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    v = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value
    if isinstance(d, datetime):
        d = d.date()
    elif not isinstance(d, date):
        continue
    if threshold < d <= today_date and isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        cached_sum += v

# Save once with openpyxl.
tmp_xlsx = output_path.with_suffix(".tmp.xlsx")
wb.save(tmp_xlsx)

# Add/replace the cached formula value for I6 in the worksheet XML.
# This preserves the formula while allowing data-only readers to see the computed result.
ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
ET.register_namespace("", ns)
sheet_xml_path = "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".xlsx") as tmp_file:
    edited_zip_path = Path(tmp_file.name)

with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_xlsx, "r") as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(edited_zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == sheet_xml_path:
            root = ET.fromstring(data)
            c_el = None
            for c in root.iter(f"{{{ns}}}c"):
                if c.attrib.get("r") == "I6":
                    c_el = c
                    break

            if c_el is not None:
                # Formula cells should not have a string type.
                c_el.attrib.pop("t", None)

                # Remove existing formula/value children for this cell only.
                for child in list(c_el):
                    if child.tag in (f"{{{ns}}}f", f"{{{ns}}}v"):
                        c_el.remove(child)

                f_el = ET.Element(f"{{{ns}}}f")
                f_el.text = formula[1:]  # XML stores formulas without the leading "="
                v_el = ET.Element(f"{{{ns}}}v")
                v_el.text = str(cached_sum)

                c_el.insert(0, f_el)
                c_el.insert(1, v_el)

                data = ET.tostring(root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

        zout.writestr(item, data)

shutil.move(str(edited_zip_path), output_path)
tmp_xlsx.unlink(missing_ok=True)
```
